svg.aria-label: Algorithm evolution across generations: each operator proposes one candidate, and complementary selection keeps k algorithms.
svg.text: Algorithm-generating LLMs receive the mathematical formulation and feedback; evaluation materials remain with the evaluator.
kept algorithms and the new candidates are evaluated on the same instances;
Operators: each proposes one new candidate per generation
Receives no existing algorithm and designs from the problem structure
Keeps the leading algorithm's framework and replaces its weakest mechanism
Diagnoses where others beat the leader, then builds a different framework
Combines the mechanisms of two algorithms that win on different instances
Finds what makes the leader stronger and pushes that mechanism further
Reviews the approaches already explored and pursues the most promising one

g.text: Evaluation feedback directs review to the construction stage
